claims: Kid Rock owns a 27,000-square-foot mansion in Whites Creek, Tennessee, near Nashville.
Kid Rock's mansion in Whites Creek, Tennessee is designed as a "mini White House" replica.
Kid Rock's property is known as the "Southern White House".
The "Southern White House" features an imitation Oval Office.
The "Southern White House" features a swimming pool with a Statue of Liberty replica.
The "Southern White House" features a bowling alley.
The "Southern White House" features a 24-karat gold-plated urinal.
Kid Rock's property is situated on a large estate about 11 miles outside downtown Nashville, TN.
Kid Rock's mansion took approximately 20 years to build.
Kid Rock's mansion includes a bar styled after the White House Mess.
Kid Rock's mansion includes a massive backyard deck.
In March 2026, the US Army initiated an investigation into a video posted by Kid Rock.
The video posted by Kid Rock showed Apache helicopters flying low over his swimming pool.
During the construction of the main home, Kid Rock lived in a nearby large manufactured home.
Kid Rock's large manufactured home is often referred to as his "double-wide".
